item.title: Rust 1.94 is Here: Sliding Window Pattern Matching Makes Code Elegant
item.description: Rust 1.94 brings three major updates: sliding windows destructured into named variables, Cargo.toml now supports multi-line syntax, and the Golden Ratio finally joins after 10 years!
